question: How many open claims does each West & South adjuster have?

input.sql: SELECT a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, a.leave_date, count(c.claim_id) FILTER (WHERE c.status='open') AS open_claims FROM adjusters a LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id WHERE a.region='West & South' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY open_claims DESC

report.interpretation: Open claims (status = 'open' on the 2026-09-30 extract, per the agreed open_claims metric) held by each adjuster whose region is West & South, based on the adjuster currently responsible for the claim. All report dates are included. Recent weeks are incomplete because of late reporting.
report.answer: West & South has 6 adjusters on file, holding 132 open claims between them. Daniel Jackson (ADJ-029) has 42, Judy Sanford (ADJ-030) 33, Charles Robinson (ADJ-028) 31 and Joshua Miller (ADJ-027) 26. Abigail Foster (ADJ-026) and Jamie Jones (ADJ-025) have none. They left on 2026-05-15 and 2026-05-01. The four remaining adjusters carry uneven loads: Daniel Jackson has about 60% more than Joshua Miller.

report.interpretation: Follow-up to the previous question. "What about NSW & ACT?" means the same measure for adjusters whose region is NSW & ACT. That measure is open claims (status = 'open' on the 2026-09-30 extract) held by the adjuster currently responsible. Recent weeks are incomplete because of late reporting.
report.answer: NSW & ACT has 9 adjusters, all still employed, holding 165 open claims between them. Derek Ortiz (ADJ-003) has the most with 26, followed by Richard Gomez with 24 and Brian Torres with 23. Joseph Cole and Jennifer Powers have 20 each. Victoria Hampton and Mark Jones have 15 each, Scott Mcintosh has 13 and Cathy Bradley has the fewest with 9. Loads are more even than in West & South, which has 4 active adjusters. In NSW & ACT the average is about 18 per adjuster. In West & South it is 33.
